def sort_document_reading_order(blocks: list[dict], page_width: float = 612.0, column_gutter_threshold: float = 30.0) -> dict:
    """Sorts 2D text bounding boxes into reading order (banners first, then column by column top-down)."""
    midpoint = page_width / 2.0
    left_column = []
    right_column = []
    full_width_headers = []

    for b in blocks:
        left = b.get("left", 0)
        width = b.get("width", 0)
        right = left + width
        if width > page_width * 0.65:
            full_width_headers.append(b)
        elif right <= midpoint + column_gutter_threshold:
            left_column.append(b)
        else:
            right_column.append(b)

    full_width_headers.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("top", 0))
    left_column.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("top", 0))
    right_column.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("top", 0))

    ordered_sequence = full_width_headers + left_column + right_column
    serialized_text = "\n".join(b.get("text", "") for b in ordered_sequence)

    return {
        "total_blocks": len(blocks),
        "layout_detected": "two_column_with_banner" if (left_column and right_column) else "single_column",
        "ordered_blocks": ordered_sequence,
        "serialized_text": serialized_text
    }

def test_sort_reading_order():
    blocks = [
        {"text": "Right Article", "left": 350, "top": 120, "width": 200},
        {"text": "Main Headline", "left": 20, "top": 10, "width": 550},
        {"text": "Left Article", "left": 30, "top": 100, "width": 200}
    ]
    res = sort_document_reading_order(blocks)
    assert res["total_blocks"] == 3
    assert res["layout_detected"] == "two_column_with_banner"
    assert res["ordered_blocks"][0]["text"] == "Main Headline"
    assert res["ordered_blocks"][1]["text"] == "Left Article"
    assert res["ordered_blocks"][2]["text"] == "Right Article"
